question: What golf course are present inside an 80 kilometers boundary toward the southeast of Susan Hambley Nature Center, Brunswick, OH?
sql:
WITH origin AS  (SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.816057 41.236319)',4326)::geography AS geometry)
SELECT * FROM pois, origin
WHERE ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.816057 41.236319)',4326)::geography, 80000)
AND leisure = 'golf_course'
AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(origin.geometry, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN 112.5 AND 157.5;

answers.poi_name: Cleveland Clinic-Akron General Challenge Golf Course

[3].display_name: Susan Hambley Nature Center, Brunswick, OH
